regression.formula: cnt ~ temp_ctr + I(temp_ctr ** 2) + hum_pct + windspeed_kmh + C(weather_group) + C(season_label) + C(year) + workingday

tests.question: Mean daily cnt: working vs non-working days
tests.method: Welch t-test + Mann-Whitney U; block-bootstrap CI for mean difference
tests.note: Mann-Whitney p = 0.119; rank-biserial r = 0.072; Cohen's d = 0.129; means 4585 vs 4330

tests.question: Mean daily casual: working vs non-working days
tests.method: Welch t-test + Mann-Whitney U; block-bootstrap CI for mean difference
tests.note: Mann-Whitney p = 3.79e-29; rank-biserial r = -0.515; Cohen's d = -1.130; means 607 vs 1371

tests.question: Mean daily registered: working vs non-working days
tests.method: Welch t-test + Mann-Whitney U; block-bootstrap CI for mean difference
tests.note: Mann-Whitney p = 1.41e-16; rank-biserial r = 0.380; Cohen's d = 0.709; means 3978 vs 2959

tests.question: Does daily cnt differ across seasons?
tests.method: Kruskal-Wallis H (one-way ANOVA as robustness check); Holm-corrected Mann-Whitney post-hoc
tests.note: ANOVA F = 128.8, p = 6.72e-67, eta² = 0.347; Levene p = 0.0214 (unequal variances -> rank test preferred)
